blur_classifier.name: People-first blur rule, stage 2 (sharp vs subject missed focus)
blur_classifier.notes: Stage 2 of the blur classifier: the person detector finds the people, src/ml/blur/people.py measures each one's sharpness at the 1280-px upload, and this logistic rule turns those numbers into P(missed focus). Whole-frame soft and motion are decided before it by src/ml/blur/whole_frame.py. Quality evidence: docs/ai-system-overview.md.

person_detector.name: YOLOv8n-seg COCO person detector (stage 2 of the blur classifier)
person_detector.notes: Only the person class (index 0) is read; each person's mask gives its own pixels for the sharpness measure. Letterbox, score filter, NMS and mask decoding live in src/ml/blur/person_detector.py, so serving needs no torch or Ultralytics. Licence AGPL-3.0 (owner decision 2026-10-06).
